name: Ordo Labs
long_description:
Ordo Labs is bringing AI into regulated labs. In paid pilots with labs in the US and Europe, Ordo cut post-analysis work by 90%+.

CROs and CDMOs are a $314.8B industry, but they can't rely on generic AI tools, because every result must be traceable, every system validated, and every change QA-approved. Ordo is the AI-native OS for regulated labs: each lab gets its own deployment built to be validated, every output links back to its source data, and scientists and QA sign off on every result. Every workflow on Ordo inherits these controls.

Live today: data analysis, quality review and reporting. We're advised by laboratory executives and have interviewed 100+ scientists. Our goal is to make regulated labs AI-native, so science can move at the speed of AI.

Run a CRO or CDMO? Email us at founders@ordolabs.ai.
one_liner: The AI-native OS for regulated labs
